summary: Builder must repair one durable docs drift before Git-master commits: docs/running_our_example_applications.md still lists the removed depth_meters_visualization frame folder and omits the new depth_meters_npy, depth_meters_viridis, and depth_meters_viridis.mp4 outputs. Code behavior and focused non-simulator validation otherwise pass.
work_completed: Reviewed examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, examples/flashlight/README.md, tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py, docs/running_our_example_applications.md, and the builder result packet.

Confirmed implementation writes raw metric depth arrays to frames/depth_meters_npy/frame_####.npy and stable viridis PNGs to frames/depth_meters_viridis/frame_####.png after accumulating a per-setting finite depth range.
Confirmed rgb.mp4 still encodes from frames/rgb, while both depth_meters_visualization.mp4 and depth_meters_viridis.mp4 encode from frames/depth_meters_viridis.

Confirmed normalization avoids per-frame flicker by using the sequence range, renders non-finite pixels black, returns black if no finite depth exists, and maps degenerate finite ranges to midpoint rather than all-black.

Ran focused validation: python -m unittest tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py passed 10 tests; python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py passed; a temporary-file smoke check for update_depth_range, raw .npy loading, write_depth_viridis_frames, OpenCV PNG reads, and invalid-pixel blacking passed.

findings.message: Blocker: docs/running_our_example_applications.md:140-143 still documents orbit_collection_output/<name>/frames/depth_meters_visualization/ and only rgb.mp4 plus depth_meters_visualization.mp4. The implementation no longer creates that depth frame folder; it creates frames/depth_meters_npy/, frames/depth_meters_viridis/, and depth_meters_viridis.mp4. This is durable docs drift in a file explicitly included in the review task.

Implementation checks passed: prepare_setting_output_dir creates the new depth_meters_npy and depth_meters_viridis frame directories, run_render saves per-frame .npy depth arrays before viridis generation, and write_depth_viridis_frames renders from those raw arrays using the shared per-setting range.

Backwards compatibility is acceptable for video consumers because legacy depth_meters_visualization.mp4 is still produced from the stable viridis frames; compatibility is not preserved for the old frames/depth_meters_visualization/ directory, which is why docs must stop advertising it.

follow_up_recommendations: Update docs/running_our_example_applications.md to list frames/rgb/, frames/depth_meters_npy/, frames/depth_meters_viridis/, rgb.mp4, depth_meters_visualization.mp4, and depth_meters_viridis.mp4, plus the stable per-setting normalization behavior.
